The catalog has only brick components, with no text, table or chart widgets. So I built the bar chart out of bricks: six bars, one per month (Jan to Jun), with height showing sales. The parts list is switched on so it works like a summary panel.

<a2ui>
surface("sales-dashboard")
root = brick_build_3d(
  bricks=[
    {x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, w: 2, d: 2, h: 3, c: 0},
    {x: 3, y: 0, z: 0, w: 2, d: 2, h: 5, c: 1},
    {x: 6, y: 0, z: 0, w: 2, d: 2, h: 4, c: 2},
    {x: 9, y: 0, z: 0, w: 2, d: 2, h: 7, c: 3},
    {x: 12, y: 0, z: 0, w: 2, d: 2, h: 6, c: 4},
    {x: 15, y: 0, z: 0, w: 2, d: 2, h: 9, c: 5}
  ],
  palette=["#2563eb", "#16a34a", "#f59e0b", "#dc2626", "#7c3aed", "#0891b2"],
  mode="animate",
  orbit=true,
  height=460,
  scrubber=true,
  checks=false,
  parts=true,
  look="studio",
  base="#e5e7eb"
)
</a2ui>
